🆕 New (Published: September 18, 2026)

About Typhoon No. 25

Typhoon No. 25 may bring heavy rain and strong winds from the weekend holiday period onward. Please be alert to flooding in low-lying areas, swollen rivers, and landslides.

Please prepare in advance

• Prepare flashlights, batteries, and portable radios

• Charge your mobile phone

• Stock drinking water

• Check the area around your home

• Move items that blow easily indoors, etc.

Sandbag distribution

The typhoon's path and strength may change

Continuously check the latest weather conditions.

Please check the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) website's "Kiki-Kuru" (hazard map) and time-series information, and stay alert to the latest disaster prevention weather information.
